a3_mechanism_control.architecture: permutation-invariant pooled local MLP: input projection to width 184, then 3 residual blocks of LayerNorm -> Linear -> ReLU -> Linear, then LayerNorm and a single logit head
a3_mechanism_control.capacity_matching_criterion: total trainable parameter count of the A3 model versus M2's recoverability-path parameter count
a3_mechanism_control.does_not_support_claim: it does not establish that any particular architectural detail of M2 is necessary, does not identify WHICH relational information matters, does not establish closed-loop or safety benefit on its own, and does not license a general claim that graph neural networks are required for recoverability
a3_mechanism_control.inputs: the SAME admitted set as M2 (node_x, node_feature_valid_mask, node_kind, edge_index, edge_attr, edge_feature_valid_mask, edge_type, root_index, candidate_topology_id), consumed as: root node features and mask, mean and max pooling over one-hop neighbor node features and masks, mean and max pooling over incident edge features and masks, and the candidate-topology embedding
a3_mechanism_control.message_passing_removal: edge_index is used ONLY to identify one-hop incidence to the root. There is no propagation between non-root nodes, no iterated exchange, and no attention. A single unordered aggregation replaces the message-passing blocks.
a3_mechanism_control.neighbor_visibility_note: neighbor information is retained through permutation-invariant pooling. Removing it would confound 'no message passing' with 'no neighbors' and would not isolate the mechanism.
a3_mechanism_control.purpose: isolate ITERATIVE MESSAGE PASSING over the ego graph, with capacity and available information held fixed
a3_mechanism_control.residual_mismatch_predeclared_limitation: exact integer capacity equality is not attainable at integer width. Width 184 is the closest achievable match and is 848 parameters BELOW M2, i.e. A3 is very slightly under-parameterised; this direction is conservative for a claim that message passing helps, since it cannot inflate A3.
a3_mechanism_control.runtime_and_checkpoint_binding_for_the_m: may be bound at CR-8; the scientific definition above is immutable from now
a3_mechanism_control.supports_claim: if full RVT beats A3 under the frozen mechanism contrast, that supports iterative message passing over the ego graph contributing beyond a capacity-matched permutation-invariant pooled model with the same inputs
a3_mechanism_control.topology_visibility_note: A3 is conditioned on the candidate topology at M2's embedding width. It is NOT the topology-blinded ablation; that contrast is A2.

training_recipe.checkpoint_rule: strict lower held-out TRAIN-R NLL; on exact tie the EARLIER step
training_recipe.initialization: framework default under torch.manual_seed(seed) plus a per-fit generator; no custom initialization scheme

training_recipe.note: identical to the frozen M2 recipe, so the contrast is not confounded by optimization settings

refit_step_rule.inputs: s_A and s_B, the selected scheduled steps for (c*, seed) on folds A and B; each is a multiple of 1000
refit_step_rule.why_ceil: the mean of two multiples of 1000 can land on a half-multiple; ceiling to the next 1000 is unambiguous and needs no half-rounding convention
refit_step_rule.why_not_rescaled: optimizer STEPS, not epochs, are the frozen budget unit; the refit therefore takes the same number of gradient updates while drawing from a 2x larger pool, which is the conservative choice

training_recipe.stopping_rule: early stopping on the held-out TRAIN-R internal fold only
training_recipe.tie_rule: on machine-visible equality choose the EARLIER checkpoint
training_recipe.weighting: identical to the frozen weighting contract

main_r_planning.pilot_information_used: NONE in the arithmetic. The pilot's decisive-event discordance counts exist and show that topology choice is decisive for a nonzero share of decision events, which is what makes any closed-loop benefit possible, but they are DECISION-EVENT quantities, not paired closed-loop episode rates, and were deliberately kept out of the sizing.
main_r_planning.planning_alternative_justification: twice the frozen practical threshold. The rule requires the LOWER 95 percent bound to exceed 0.08, so the true effect must clear the threshold by roughly the width of the bound. Setting the minimum detectable effect at 2x the frozen threshold uses only frozen numbers and introduces nothing outcome-derived.
main_r_planning.variance_model: arms treated as INDEPENDENT with worst-case Bernoulli variance 0.25 each, so Var(delta) = 0.5/n. The real design is PAIRED by source episode, and pairing can only reduce variance, so this is strictly conservative.

pilot_reconstruction.task_expansion_semantics: the frozen acquisition rule REALIZED_TRAJECTORY_UNIFORM_K selects at most K = 5 decision events per source episode. 'Tasks' in the pilot manifests are SOURCE EPISODES; decision events are the K-bounded expansion of each, and actual yield is data-dependent, which is why zero-yield episodes exist and are retained.

CL-DEV-R.purpose: closed-loop controller development and the oracle ceiling
CL-DEV-R.sizing_basis: precision-based: at 300 episodes a 95 percent interval on an episode rate has half-width 0.057 at the worst-case rate, adequate for development ranking, and the universe is reused across all logged configurations so comparisons stay paired. Kept to the smallest balanced multiple because up to 40 configurations are run over it.

MAIN-R.sizing_basis: prospective power: 900 episodes gives 0.96 power against a planning alternative of twice the frozen 0.08 threshold, under a deliberately conservative variance model. 600 would give only 0.87.

MECH-R.sizing_basis: fixed at MAIN-R's size, which satisfies the conservative rule of being at least as large as MAIN-R. Each mechanism contrast is its own paired comparison on the same universe, so each inherits MAIN-R's power.

PROTECTED-R.purpose: final generalization to unseen layout instances within known families
PROTECTED-R.sizing_basis: precision-based: 600 episodes gives a 95 percent interval half-width of 0.040 at the worst-case rate, tighter than the 0.05 target, for an estimation role that runs no hypothesis test.

SELECT-R.sizing_basis: preserves the official pilot VALIDATION selection-evidence budget exactly: 300 source episodes, 6 per (family, team size) cell, one layout per family.

TRAIN-R.purpose: train the final clean-room predictors from scratch
TRAIN-R.sizing_basis: preserves the official pilot TRAIN scientific budget exactly: 1200 source episodes and 24 episodes per (family, team size) cell. The pilot reached that with two layout variants per family; TRAIN-R reaches it with one, because V3 froze TRAIN-R to a single offset.

primary_endpoints.definition: per-episode indicator that no robot-robot separation fell below 0.4 m and no robot-obstacle separation fell below 0.55 m at any control step; the frozen simulator predicate collision_free
primary_endpoints.interval: paired stratified cluster bootstrap over source episodes, stratified by layout, 10000 replicates, seed 20260901, one-sided 95 percent bound on the harmful side
primary_endpoints.margin_justification: the pilot's frozen collision gate already fixes absolute_degradation_maximum = 0.01; reused verbatim, not re-derived
primary_endpoints.pass_rule: lower95(treatment - comparator) > -margin; AND the treatment point estimate must be at least the absolute floor
primary_endpoints.treatment_contrast: full recoverability-aware RVT minus the frozen no-recoverability reactive comparator B1

primary_endpoints.definition: per-episode minimum over all control steps and all pairs of (separation minus the required clearance for that pair type), reported jointly for robot-robot and robot-obstacle
primary_endpoints.interval: paired stratified cluster bootstrap over source episodes, stratified by layout, 10000 replicates, seed 20260901, one-sided 95 percent bound on the harmful side
primary_endpoints.margin_justification: one half of the tightest engineered surface margin in the frozen configuration (0.020000000000000018 m = min_ro_distance 0.55 minus physical contact 0.53), so at worst-allowed degradation at least half of that engineered buffer survives
primary_endpoints.treatment_contrast: full recoverability-aware RVT minus the frozen no-recoverability reactive comparator B1

primary_endpoints.definition: per-episode fraction of control steps whose minimum pairwise time-to-collision is below 1.5 s, computed by the frozen rvt_swarm.safety.time_to_collision
primary_endpoints.interval: paired stratified cluster bootstrap over source episodes, stratified by layout, 10000 replicates, seed 20260901, one-sided 95 percent bound on the harmful side
primary_endpoints.margin_justification: the same engineering tolerance class as the frozen collision gate's absolute_degradation_maximum, applied to a precursor endpoint; the threshold itself is the physical braking time max_speed / max_acceleration = 0.9 / 0.6
primary_endpoints.treatment_contrast: full recoverability-aware RVT minus the frozen no-recoverability reactive comparator B1

primary_endpoints.definition: per-episode indicator of actual geometric body overlap: robot-robot separation below 0.36 m or robot-obstacle separation below 0.53 m
primary_endpoints.interval: paired stratified cluster bootstrap over source episodes, stratified by layout, 10000 replicates, seed 20260901, one-sided 95 percent bound on the harmful side
primary_endpoints.margin_justification: half the frozen collision-gate margin, because this endpoint is physical contact and is strictly more severe than a clearance-gate violation; the margin is monotone in severity
primary_endpoints.treatment_contrast: full recoverability-aware RVT minus the frozen no-recoverability reactive comparator B1

secondary_endpoints.definition: per-episode fraction of control steps at which the local safety projection altered the nominal command
secondary_endpoints.justification: diagnostic only; it carries no pass/fail rule because a higher intervention rate is not itself a harm

safety_contract.status: FULLY_SPECIFIED_AT_CR0R -- no safety margin is deferred to CL-DEV-R or CR-8
safety_contract.ttc_threshold_justification: the full braking time from top speed, max_speed / max_acceleration = 0.9 / 0.6 = 1.5 s; below it a collision cannot be avoided by braking alone

sample_size_claim_boundary.MAIN-R: a confirmatory design sized by prospective power
sample_size_claim_boundary.TRAIN-R: a training-budget choice; it licenses no scientific claim
sample_size_claim_boundary.identity_disjoint_is_not_independent_dis: identity-disjoint role universes are NOT independent distributions; all six draw from the same known layout families
sample_size_claim_boundary.protected_r_is_not_ood: PROTECTED-R tests unseen layout INSTANCES within known families F1-F10. It is not unseen-family or out-of-distribution generalization.

training_recipe.checkpoint_rule: strict lower held-out TRAIN NLL; on exact tie the EARLIER step
training_recipe.fits_per_learned_family: 3 seeds x 2 folds for step determination, then 3 refits
training_recipe.hyperparameter_search_on_TRAIN_R: NONE -- the configuration is frozen here as a constant, informed by pilot development. This removes the pilot's 72-fit search and every TRAIN-R-outcome-dependent hyperparameter decision.

refit_step_rule.inputs: s_A and s_B, the selected scheduled steps for (c*, seed) on folds A and B; each is a multiple of 1000
refit_step_rule.why_ceil: the mean of two multiples of 1000 can land on a half-multiple; ceiling to the next 1000 is unambiguous and needs no half-rounding convention
refit_step_rule.why_not_rescaled: optimizer STEPS, not epochs, are the frozen budget unit; the refit therefore takes the same number of gradient updates while drawing from a 2x larger pool, which is the conservative choice

shared.initialization: framework default under torch.manual_seed(seed) plus a per-fit generator; no custom initialization scheme
shared.tie_rule: on machine-visible equality choose the EARLIER checkpoint

weighting.replica_supervision: divided by R through the frozen grouped Bernoulli NLL
weighting.short_final_batch: averaged over its own event count, so every event stays equally weighted within its step

training_recipe.stopping_rule: early stopping on the held-out TRAIN-R internal fold only; VALIDATION-class data is never used for stopping

train_internal_folds.balance: each fold contains exactly one layout per family f1-f10
train_internal_folds.membership_authority: the frozen clean-room TRAIN-R registry, never the layout-id string
